headline: Manchester City’s trip to Anfield and is Eckert’s Spygate ban too lenient? – Football Weekly podcast
body: Max Rushden is joined by Barry Glendenning, Nicky Bandini and Paul Watson to preview the return of the Premier League Rate, review, share on Apple Podcasts and join the conversation on email . On the podcast today; the Premier League returns and narrative fans couldn’t ask for a better game for Manchester City Liverpool (away), with the Reds so often the side City just pipped to the title. Even Enzo Maresca’s pre-match press conference might be worth watching, while it should be fascinating to see how the atmosphere at Anfield affects the City players. Continue reading...
